entries.en: The restorer identified nickel bronze in the damaged fitting.
entries.zh: 修复师在受损配件中鉴定出了镍青铜。

entries.en: The instrument maker polished a key made from nickel silver.
entries.zh: 乐器制作师擦亮了一个镍银制成的按键。

entries.en: The engineering report compared two grades of nickel steel.
entries.zh: 工程报告比较了两个等级的镍钢。

entries.en: The cracked turbine component was made from a nickel-base alloy.
entries.zh: 开裂的涡轮部件是用一种镍基合金制成的。

entries.en: A night bird called from the trees beyond the campsite.
entries.zh: 一只夜间活动的鸟在营地远处的树林中鸣叫。

entries.en: A night heron waited beside the water under the bridge.
entries.zh: 一只夜鹭在桥下的水边等候。

entries.en: Night jasmine grew beside the veranda behind the house.
entries.zh: 夜香树生长在房屋后面的外廊旁。

entries.en: The zoology collection included a preserved night lizard.
entries.zh: 动物学收藏中有一只保存下来的夜蜥科蜥蜴标本。
